rows.text: walks the circular list whose sentinel is `rcx+8`, from qword `+8` through qword `+0` of each node, stopping at the first node whose object at qword `+0x10` has dword `+0x38` equal to `edx`; then calls `00219BC0` + 0x41 with the incoming registers unchanged and, only when a node matched, calls `00219BC0` + 0x59 with (that object, the first call's result, `edx`, `r8`); returns the first call's result on both paths
